title: ADS — V&V Plan
description: DRM 1 verification & validation plan. Results are filled by executable Julia tests (#VULCAN_VNV).

records.title: Sunlit accuracy
records.text: Steady-state attitude determination accuracy shall be <= 0.05 deg (1-sigma) per axis under sunlit conditions with star tracker + gyro available.
records.acceptanceCriteria: 1-sigma per-axis error <= 0.05 deg over the steady-state window.

records.title: Eclipse accuracy
records.text: During eclipse the ADS shall maintain attitude knowledge using magnetometer + gyro with accuracy degraded to <= 0.5 deg (1-sigma) per axis.
records.acceptanceCriteria: 1-sigma per-axis error <= 0.5 deg over an eclipse pass.

records.title: Convergence
records.text: The MEKF shall converge from a 5 deg initial attitude error to within 0.1 deg in <= 60 s under sunlit conditions.
records.acceptanceCriteria: Attitude error < 0.1 deg by t = 60 s.

records.title: Filter consistency
records.text: The MEKF shall pass NEES/NIS consistency within 95% chi-square bounds over a Monte Carlo of >= 100 trials.
records.acceptanceCriteria: Mean NEES within chi-square(3) 95% interval; >=90% of samples within bounds.

records.title: Star tracker model
records.text: Star tracker shall model 5 arcsec/axis (1-sigma) measurement noise with a 15 deg FOV and sun-exclusion masking.
records.acceptanceCriteria: Measured noise distribution consistent with 5 arcsec (goodness-of-fit p > 0.05).

records.title: Gyro model
records.text: Gyro shall model angle random walk 0.1 deg/sqrt(hr) and bias instability 1 deg/hr; bias estimated as 3-state augmentation.
records.acceptanceCriteria: ARW and bias statistics consistent with spec.

records.title: Magnetometer model
records.text: Magnetometer shall draw the reference field from the environment model and add 50 nT/axis (1-sigma) noise; output normalized.
records.acceptanceCriteria: Angular noise distribution consistent with 50 nT on the ambient field.

records.title: Sun sensor model
records.text: Coarse sun sensor shall provide body-frame sun direction with 1 deg/axis (1-sigma) noise, valid only when not eclipsed and within a 70 deg FOV.
records.acceptanceCriteria: Angular noise distribution consistent with 1 deg; validity gating correct.

vnvEntries.verificationPlan: Run a sunlit orbit MEKF simulation; compute per-axis 1-sigma attitude error over the steady-state window; emit error-vs-time plot and 1-sigma metric vs 0.05 deg.
Simulate an eclipse pass (star tracker + sun sensor invalid); propagate on gyro with magnetometer updates; emit error-vs-time plot and 1-sigma metric vs 0.5 deg.
Initialize 5 deg attitude error; run 60 s; emit convergence curve and final-error metric vs 0.1 deg.
Run >=100 MC trials; collect NEES; emit NEES histogram with chi-square(3) 95% bounds and mean-NEES metric.
Draw >=2000 samples; emit histogram of per-axis angular error with fitted Gaussian; report estimated sigma vs 5 arcsec and a goodness-of-fit p-value.
Allan-variance / sample statistics of the gyro model; emit distribution plot; report ARW and bias-instability vs spec.
Draw >=2000 samples; emit angular-noise histogram; report estimated sigma vs the 50 nT-equivalent angle.
Draw >=2000 samples; emit angular-noise histogram; report estimated sigma vs 1 deg and validity-gating check.
